The '''Plasma Energy Trade Commission''' was one of the most powerful corporations on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], led by [[Arnama]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomirian witch]] [[Silri]] led a strike force of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] to attack Arnama. He gave in to the Consortium, and the most powerful group on the planet was indirectly controlled by it.
